description: The record of the context layer: output contract, attempts, examples, context caps, prompt layout and caching, processing mode and release path, with the forces, alternatives and consequences behind them.
The implementable part of the decision: prompt version, environments, output mode and attempts, example strategy, layout and cache breakpoint, context budget, processing mode and cost projection.
The maximum number of model calls per request, chosen where the validity target and the latency budget both hold.
The end of the prompt prefix that is identical across requests and can be cached. Everything after it may vary.
Tokens kept free in the context window for the reply. Input budget = window − reserve.
